selection_validation: 24 targets, 8 actors, 3 different emotions per actor; video-only human emotion accuracy >=0.8 and alternate audio-only >=0.7; strong-normal mean intensity gap >=0.4 visual and >=0.5 auditory; no candidate model outputs consulted

Source labels and actual delivered audio, not self-reported labels.

engineering_gates.name: 成片可解码并含实际音轨
engineering_gates.rule: final.mp4 and mix.wav exist; decoded final video metadata and actual soundtrack available.

engineering_gates.name: 可追溯来源日志与成片音轨一致
engineering_gates.rule: 24/24 per-shot source/role logs match executed native plan; final-vs-mix SDR>=20dB and length difference<=50ms.

engineering_gates.name: REAPER 工程可重放且与混音一致
engineering_gates.rule: session.rpp exists; native replay equal length; RMS difference<=-60dBFS.

engineering_gates.name: Shotcut 工程与锁画规格完整
